_help: Where the job finder looks. Setup guide: top of .github/workflows/fetch-jobs.yml. Keys that start with an underscore are notes and are ignored.
_greenhouseFormat: Add one entry per company: { "token": "BOARD_TOKEN", "company": "Name to show" }. The token is the word after boards.greenhouse.io/ or job-boards.greenhouse.io/ in one of the company's job links.
_leverFormat: Add one entry per company: { "name": "COMPANY_NAME", "company": "Name to show" }. The name is the word after jobs.lever.co/ in one of the company's job links. Add "region": "eu" if the link starts with jobs.eu.lever.co.
_remotiveHelp: Remotive asks for 4 requests a day at most and lists jobs 24 hours late. Each category is one request, so 2 categories x 2 run hours = 4 a day. Change runHoursUtc only if you also change the number of categories.
_jobicyHelp: Jobicy is free with no key or payment. Each search is one request per run. Keep it to a few searches: its guide asks for no more than one polling run an hour. industry = a category slug (marketing), tag = a keyword (3 to 50 letters), geo = optional region such as usa.

_adzunaFormat: Turned off: Adzuna needs keys and may need payment. Each search can also use "where": "city or state" and "whatExclude": "words to leave out". Needs the ADZUNA_APP_ID and ADZUNA_APP_KEY secrets.
_prefilterHelp: A broad first cut so the feed file stays small. Jobs are kept only when the title contains one of titleKeywords (empty list = keep all). The app then applies your exact keywords from Settings.
